items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: If he even had a reserve of something like Bud Freeman, I would dig it.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, and come up with a brand new sound which might be a synthesis of what he's doing and something else that's out there right now in front of him. Yeah.
If he even had a reserve of something like Bud Freeman, I would dig it. But he doesn't have any reserve.

items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: I respect Woody. He's a fine guy... Dave Tough went with Woody Herman... gave Woody Herman a band that Woody was never to have again

ctx.x: Sure and he wouldn't have altered it.

He would be an institution. Take the case of Woody Herman today, he's an institution. He can go on as long as he wants to work. Because he's done it. He has done a great job. He's a lovely guy and he is marvelous -- I saw him the other night on unintelligible show here. He's an institution.
Benny Goodman is an institution. Tommy Dorsey, Glenn Miller, they are institutions. So it didn't make much difference what they did, but I think that Sy Oliver gave Tommy a whole new life.
